integrity: Integer-only exact 64/512-case enumerator and direct full Walsh minor rank/determinant checks, with a reproducible standalone Python 3 checker.
scientific_limitations: Only fourth-order restriction submatrices of Boolean-group Walsh matrices, not arbitrary Hadamard matrices. An independently checked mathematical proof is not claimed; historical priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
